clue.text: Place occupied by revolutionary artist next to lover of luxury

indicators.note: a place occupied by something has it sitting inside, so the place word is cut open

parts.note: a site is a place

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the artist and the next-to word are read backwards together

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
by means next to, as in standing by the door

explanation.surface: A rebel painter living in a building beside a pleasure-seeker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns the artist and 'next to' together, giving YBAR for 'occupied by' to place. Sybaris was an ancient Greek city notorious for luxury.
explanation.definitionFit: A sybarite is a self-indulgent person devoted to pleasure and comfort, named after the decadent Greek city of Sybaris.

clue.text: Unconscious irregularity? Not quite — there's large ill feeling rising about that!

explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns the ill feeling upwards to give SUMINA; 'Not quite' cuts the last letter off the irregularity; 'about' wraps the risen word plus L round that remnant.
explanation.definitionFit: Subliminal means below the threshold of conscious awareness, perceived without being noticed.

clue.text: Silly behaviour from enthusiast, rather losing head and beginning to yell

explanation.walkthrough: 'losing head' takes S from SOONER to leave OONER.

clue.text: Elements of real issue that are odd to bring up
